project: Сценарии и промпты для видеоролика (Аист и Космолеты)

model_info.video_generation_model: Google Video Generation Model (Veo / Imagen Video Architecture)

generations.prompt_en: A tired white stork barely flying out of heavy clouds, holding a heavy sagging net filled with glowing glass orbs without any text or labels. In the upper bright sky, sleek ultra-futuristic white spaceships without text zoom past at extreme speed, leaving vibrant neon light trails. Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, clean image, no text, no letters, no logos
